$comment: SideStore source manifest. Canonical copy lives at sidestore/source.json in the ramus repo; .github/workflows/sidestore-sync.yml mirrors it to 1337raspberry/1337raspberry.github.io/ramus.json so SideStore clients fetch from the short URL below. Users add the sourceURL in SideStore → Sources. The release workflow uploads `ramus_<version>_ios-adhoc.ipa` to each draft release; prepend new entries to versions[] when cutting a release. Versions array MUST be reverse-chronological; SideStore picks index 0 as latest. SideStore-specific quirk vs AltStore: the top-level downloadURL on each app is required even when versions[] is present — keep it in sync with versions[0].
name: ramus
subtitle: Cross-platform Plex music player
description: A Plex music player focused on a fast, distinctive UI and offline-friendly playback. iOS builds are ad-hoc signed in CI and re-signed by SideStore at install time.

apps.name: ramus
apps.subtitle: Plex music player
apps.localizedDescription: A cross-platform music player for Plex media servers. Supports direct play and on-the-fly transcoding, background playback with lock-screen controls, downloads for offline listening, search with operator syntax (/genre, @artist, !track, #year), bookmarks, equaliser, and per-track spectrum visualisation on desktop.
apps.versionDescription: Initial SideStore source. The iOS build is produced by the unified release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) and uploaded as an ad-hoc-signed IPA — SideStore re-signs it with your Apple ID at install time.

permissions.usageDescription: Lets ramus keep playing music when the screen is locked or the app is backgrounded.
ramus needs local network access to find Plex servers on your home network.
